notes.content:
Feedback demanding rest days give inspiration to everyone in the party has been heard, and it is now the case!

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
Fixed a bug where reaching the last day with exactly enough rations will lock the game.

(Attempted to) fix a rare bug where network desync causes a card from a previous action play instead of the intended card. The applied fix should prevent this, but if you encounter such bug, please report it and send logs so we can actually fix it. [h2]Balance[/h2]
We're monitoring reports about players struggling with 4 players mode due to excessive difficulty. Your opinion is valuable - let us know.

And as always, stay hydrated.

notes.title: 1.0 Release + Patch notes + Discount!
notes.content:
At long last, we are delighted to welcome you to Azoove's final vision, realized.
Thank you for sticking with us during Early Access! 
There will be more updates, bringing additional features we want to add in the future.

[h1]4 players[/h1]
And 3 as well

Play with 3 or 4 people! 
Bring your friend group, your family and even a double date to the Azoove experience.

[h3]New Rules[/h3]
These rules are specifically relevant to 3 and 4 players:

Rations are doubled! You consume 1 ration PER HERO per turn, which enables smooth scaling into 3/4 players. Since everything in 2 players was doubled, it plays exactly the same. You will not have an odd number of rations in 2 player.

Targeting: All is now [b]Both[/b]. For 2 players, it just targets both. For 3-4, you must choose one target, and one target [b]must be yourself[/b]

[h2]Spoilers: unique 3-4 player mechanics for people who want to discover them on their own[/h2]

[spoiler]Misfortunes only apply to two players, the rest draw [b]Mishaps[/b].
Misfortunes that have both effects target players who did not draw Mishaps, and choice effects only let these two players volunteer.

[b]Mishaps:[/b] new deck of 12 mini Misfortunes that piles on random issues to mitigate. This only starts on day 2, to accommodate the tutorial flow and difficulty curve.

[b]Clockwise:[/b] pass cards clockwise, receiving cards and Inspiration from a different player than the one you send cards to[/spoiler]

[h1]New Lobby[/h1]
[i]Quick anecdote: with the old lobby, if 4 people join, no one could ever switch characters![/i]

[h3]What changed?[/h3]
Lobby now shows heroes and players separately.

Hero powers no longer show in lobby, but can be checked in the [spoiler]Equipment menu, for trinket selection. This is to avoid new players getting confused by the hero powers.[/spoiler]

Hero strengths and weaknesses instead are shown in lobby, but only for players who already played the game. [i]We think people speculating about characters before having played at all is unhelpful.[/i]

Hero Bios now show up instead on character selection. [i]We think choosing characters based on their narrative background is best for first time players.[/i]

Hosts can now kick human players.

Buttons to choose a random hero, to unselect a hero and to pick a random hero that will only be selected on game start were added to lobby.

Host can now see which players are ready.
Players can now see who is the host.

[3-4 players] Lobby Hosts can now [spoiler]reorder players to determine the order in which cards are passed between them[/spoiler]

[h2]Starting Conditions[/h2]
[b]Preparation[/b]: 
Changed available resource ranges:
Rations changed from 3/4/5/6 to 6/8/10/12 to account for doubling the rations.
Bless changed from 0-2 to 0-1 (starting with 2 blesses is too powerful).

Added buttons to empty, fully hill the preparation..
Added button to set Preparation to a challenging value based on the set Spite level..

Spite: 
1: [3-4 players] [spoiler] Mishaps now start day 1 instead of day 2 [/spoiler]
3: Navigation Anxiety: now gives +1 Stress for [b]EACH HERO[/b] (impacts 2 players as well)
9: Fiendish Sabotage now removes 1 Ration PER HERO
10: Replaced with Fiendish difficulty, which adds a final, most terrifying stage to the Misfortunes.

[h2]Trinkets[/h2]
To avoid this list becoming even larger, there is no complete details of trinket changes. Instead, a summary:
Lodestone Charm: nerfed to -1 Stress instead of -2
Veteran's Belt: reworked
Cardsharp's Deck: [renamed from Homeland Heirloom]: slightly buffed
Tactician's Text: buffed to +4 Inspiration instead of 3
Nightwatch Lantern: reworked

[h3]5 new Trinkets added![/h3]
[i]If you farmed all the achievements, you already have them unlocked![/i]

You may only pick each trinket once across an adventuring group now. This does not apply to the Boots.

[h1]Biomes[/h1]
Misfortunes now are divided into 3 biomes: [b]Dunes, Mesas, Chasms[/b]

[h2]Each Biome has its own background Art and Music[/h2]
The hero you are playing also contributes their personal touch on the music playing.
[spoiler]Spot rare and common animal friends in the backgrounds![/spoiler]

[h1]Sound[/h1]
While on the topic, sound effects have been improved to be more streamlined, match better animation times and express heroes' actions

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
The new tutorial also explains 3-4 player rules when playing 3-4 players.
Added a special pop-up to explain 3-4 player rules for players who played 2 players first, even if the tutorial is disabled.

[h1]UI improvements[/h1]

[h3]New icons for: Misfortune, Spite, Inspiration[/h3]

[h3]Looks[/h3]
The tutorial and tooltips were updated with new, shorter texts.
Settings button returned to the top right, and now looks much prettier.
Moved around icons on the hero tray to better use screen space.
Added hoverable icons that show what Opportunity was played by each hero, even after they resolved.
[3-4 players] Added hoverable icons that show [spoiler]Mishaps drawn by that player, and which heroes are involved in the current Misfortune[/spoiler]
Holding down the "more info" button now cycles through the played opportunities, as a replacement for controller players for the hoverable icon.
Opportunity Cards now smoothly animate across and not longer are as jumpy.
Updated backgrounds to work well in resolutions between 16:10 (steam deck) and 32:9 (ultra wide).

[h3]Functional[/h3]
Targeting UI now has buttons in the middle of the screen to make selection easier, especially with controller. This is in addition to the good old click on portrait.

All opportunities will now flip over before starting to resolve them one by one, such that targeting people can take other upcoming effects into their choice, and discussion can be had with all information available to everyone.

The End Game UI now has a button for the host to requeue a new lobby straight away. This enables a button for the rest of the players to join that lobby without having to open the steam overlay or type in a code.

Added confirmation dialogs for some lobby actions for clarity when other players cause changes such as disbanding a lobby.

[h1]Misfortunes[/h1]
[i]Changes related to the doubling of Rations omitted here[/i]
Normal difficulty Misfortunes, which you are guaranteed to see day 1 for a new player now all have 3 opportunities.

Baffling Banshee: reworked from [1 Stress 1 Despair -2 Ration -1 Orientation to [2 Stress -2 Ration -2 Orientation +2 Inspiration]
Crying Critter: reworked from [4 Stress 2 Despair -2 Ration 6 Inspire] to [10 Stress 1 Despair 4 Inspire]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
We call them [strike]features[/strike] food. Toucans eat bugs.
But seriously: if you find any, please report them using the in game button!

[h1]Looking forward[/h1]
A few significant features are still missing. Another major update is expected in Q3 for these features, the most important of which is Localization. We will make a post when we know the timeline and language set we will be able to localize the game to. 

Stay Hydrated (+2 Rations)

notes.title: Azoove on the Steam Deck
notes.content:
This isn’t new, but we wanted to make it official, Azoove fully supports controllers and runs smoothly on the Steam Deck. This post is simply to confirm compatibility and will be linked on our store page.

You can play either with:
- Controller mode: Navigate with the D-Pad and use A/B to select or cancel.
- Touchscreen mode
- Trackpad as a mouse, just like on PC.

We've designed the default Steam Input layout for the best possible experience on the Deck but we’re always open to feedback! Let us know if you have suggestions for improvements or alternative layouts, especially for accessibility needs.

One more note: Steam Deck support is part of our broader goal to encourage in-person play. Azoove shines when players are face-to-face—the added layer of expression brings the social dynamic to life.

Azoove's 1.0 release is coming up May 1st! We are so excited.

tags.feature: Azoove fully supports controllers and runs smoothly on the Steam Deck.

notes.title: Patch 0.11.5
notes.content:
[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Misfortunes[/h3]
You may or may not know that Misfortunes are divided to 3 difficulties: normal, hard and brutal.
We've moved some Misfortunes between tiers and adjusted their effects to create a better experience for new players who could have been getting Misfortunes that are suboptimal on the first day of their first game.

Also, no normal Misfortunes (that could appear day 1 on Spite 0) will have 2 Opportunities anymore. Up to 3. Many other, harsher Misfortunes now only give 2 Opportunities.

The expected result is that Azoove will be slightly easier on the first few runs and slightly harder on higher difficulty runs. Extra draw trinkets should feel more meaningful at higher Spite.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
Adjusted some prompt texts, locations and UI layers for clarity and usability

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
Fixed a bug where extra Opportunity draws from some trinkets would not work


Rest, but only twice!

notes.title: January Early Access Update: Trinkets!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, heroes![/h3]
Azoove is changing, and there are a lot more opportunities to experience the journey differently.
Full release is coming up (we'll let you know when we know when that is) and we can't wait to see Azoove manifested fully as imagined!

[h2]Trinkets![/h2]
Trinkets replace heroes' passive abilities.
You start with no trinkets, and unlock them as you get achievements.
Each hero has their own trinket, acquired by winning with them, but they are now interchangeable!
There are 10 in total, with more planned in the future!
Trinkets change the game, making certain cards more powerful and adjusting prioritization, so every new Trinket introduces another twist to keep your wits together as you evaluate and find the optimal plays.

[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Interface[/h3]
Trinkets trigger visually, including effects previously unanimated such as Inspiration gained when healed.
Trinkets show up on heroes' bars
Tooltips improved and placed such that holding alt/right trigger shows all info needed to learn the UI

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
Added lobby tutorial prompts for progression mechanics: Preparation, Spite and now Trinkets, which will show up when first encountering these mechanics

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
Revised achievements and their art!
Achievements unlock Trinkets.
Some Achievements don't unlock anything [b]yet[/b]. Consider getting them early ;)

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
Expect an update in Feb or Mar for general polish and QoL, followed by the 1.0 update!

With such a big balance change, we would love to hear your experience, especially if you just started playing Azoove. Best way to do so is on the [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]Discord[/url].

[h3]Board game[/h3]
Azoove, the board game, is on hold until the 1.0 release digitally. Thank you for your patience.

[h1]Stay Hydrated![/h1]

notes.title: December Early Access Update: Controller Support
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
Finally, controller players are now able to enjoy Azoove. This change was important to us in particular as it enables people to choose the device most comfortable for them - adaptive controllers in particular.

[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Full Controller Support[/h3]
- Press left trigger to see all tooltips (new players will be told this in the tutorial)
- You won't believe how many tiny issues were dealt with to get this working :D

[h3]UI changes[/h3]
- Winning sequence improved
- Button graphics polished, updated for consistency
- You can now use the digital keyboard to use the text input in order to join a match by ID on Steam Decks
- The interactions between the [esc/cancel] action and various UI states has been improved for better intuitive interactions

[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed Spite 3 and 4 being swapped.
- After Sharing, the skip button will change to indicate you are waiting on your ally.
- Fixed sorting issues causing occasional Opportunity tooltips to be hiding behind the player portrait._
- Fixed some pop-ups from interfering with some other elements in certain resolutions

[h2]What's next[/h2]
Hopefully the Steam Deck certification goes smoothly.
Next we will be working on a new gameplay feature to offer more exciting ways to get lost in the desert.

This is the last update for 2024. See you next year!
[h3]And as always, Stay Hydrated![/h3]

notes.title: October Early Access Update: Quality of life
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Back after a short break with a bunch of changes, improving the Azoove experience one step at a time!

[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Action Cards renamed to Energy Cards[/h3]

[h3]Hero Barks[/h3]
- Heroes speak when being targeted, such as healing, inspiration and bless.
- Day transition tips changed to be from the perspective of heroes.

[h3]UI changes[/h3]
- Shared Opportunity shows next to target ally!
- Misfortune now represent their difficulty by the icons on the top left of the card.
- Confirmation dialogs improved for readability, added new one for wasteful assist.
- Camp action particles animations improved.
- Spite effect list improved.
- better animation for sharing and selecting opportunities.
- Tooltips updated for clarity.

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
- Mesa Mishap: changed to be an Injury choice, and moved to hard difficulty from normal.
- Nourishing Dish: Increased cost from 23 to 24. Heal amount increased from 1 to 2.
- Found Forage: Decreased cost from 23 to 22.
- Safe Sands: Increased cost from 18 to 26, Orientation gained increased from 1 to 2.

[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
- skip button now disabled on start of game.
- spamming spacebar no longer able to skip sharing.
- Fixed AI disregarding assists.
- Fixed cards showing wrong deck origins for cards shared with non-hosts while resolving actions.

[h3]Discord[/h3]
Discord rich presence is now showing when you play Azoove!

[h2]What's next[/h2]
We're working on Controller support. While most players play with a mouse + keyboard, accessibility is important to us so we are making sure every controller can be mapped to play Azoove.

[h2]And as always, Stay Hydrated![/h2]

notes.title: October update / Price increase notice
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

This is a quick update about upcoming changes to Azoove

[h2]Price adjustment[/h2]
As mentioned in the Early access section, we have decided to adjust the price up to 15usd or equivalent in other currencies. 
This is to represent the major effort our artists and writers have out into the game, as well as reward early supporters like most of you reading this.

[h2]Upcoming features[/h2]
The October update will be mostly polish and minor features. It will not change gameplay significantly.
The November update will hopefully add additional replay value and other quality of life features.

[h2]Single player[/h2]
What game makes single player after multiplayer? We do weird things here at Timeless Toucan.
We want to make single player better, and will work on some of that for the rest of the year!

[h2]Discord[/h2]
please join the [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]discord[/url] if you can, we would love to hear your feedback and ideas and make sure we are providing you the best experience we can!

notes.title: August Early Access Update + PAX West
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, heroes![/h3]
Thank you to all who have been traversing Azoove so far.
As always, your feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]Discord[/url] server is greatly appreciated!
If you are around PAX West, you're invited to be hype with us at booth 2836, next to PAX Arena!

[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Mechanics and balance[/h3]
Starting health for all heroes increased to 4. This allows 1 damage to not be immediately answered without severe punishment.
Misfortunes may now contain Injury (choice) effects. A hero must volunteer to take the damage. With the automated ally, the human player gets to pick between them.

[h3]Misfortunes[/h3]
12 new Misfortunes, adjustments and balance for many existing ones
Also, rewritten ALL Misfortunes, so try reading them again (I know you stopped!)

[h3]Opportunities[/h3]
Opportunities now have full art! 
They are also updated for balance and flavor text rewritten

[h3]Interface[/h3]
Improved Lobby, making it clearer how to start a new match or join an existing one
New camp action UI polished
Added a few new tutorial-y alerts: Over-blessed, Choice Misfortunes

[h3]Preparation and Spite[/h3]
Preparation no longer has increased health (since it is increased by default), now has starting inspiration, costs adjusted to add to 100.
Spite levels swapped and replaced to create smoother, more interesting scaling.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
Fixed some bugs causing soft-locks in multiplayer
Fixed many visual issues

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
Trinkets (what are they? you'll see)
Controller support
Localization

[h2]Lastly[/h2]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
The response to the new tutorial has been great, let us know if you have further feedback.

[h3]Sale for PAX West[/h3]
This is a great time to get your friends to buy a copy and join you!

[h3]Board game[/h3]
Azoove, the board game, is still under development! Stay tuned.

notes.title: June Early Access Update: Onboarding
notes.content:
[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Taxonomy[/h3]
Disasters are renamed to Misfortunes to better represent their place in the story
Some Opportunities were renamed in preparation for individual [i]Opportunity art[/i]

[h3][b]New Tutorial[/b][/h3]
- Now part of the regular gameplay instead of a separated experience
- Updated Intro text
- Tutorial can be played in Co-op with either or both players experiencing it
- More feedback needed!

[h3]Heroic Chatter[/h3]
Heroes now comment about their experiences as you travel, sharing some of their stories.
This is a step towards revealing the [i]true ending[/i] with the full release of Azoove!

[h3]UI changes[/h3]
- Better tooltips
- Misfortune date available after transitions
- Phase wheel to indicate game phases and the passage of time
- Instructions per phase to help new players
- Misfortunes are animated
- Animation for Bless to show the card changing
- List of all active Spite levels, as well as indications as to when Spite is taking effect
- Alerts for important events such as imminent starvation and losing Action Cards to low health
- Early Access welcome message

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
- Increased cost of many Opportunities
- Nerfed a few powerful interactions
- Buffed a few Opportunities to play better with their heroes' kits
- Spite system reworked to challenge stronger players but avoid terrible feeling moments

[h2]What's next[/h2]
[h3]UI polish minor update coming August[/h3]
[h3]September Major update with 12 new Misfortunes, Beautiful art and new surprise mechanics[/h3]

[h2]And as always, thanks for playing![/h2]

notes.title: May Early Access Update: Personalized Opportunities
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, travelers![/h3]
Thank you to all who have been traversing Azoove so far.
As always, your feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]Discord[/url] server is greatly appreciated!

[h2]Change list[/h2]

[h3]Opportunities[/h3]
Opportunity decks used to be 20 pairs of common cards and 10 rare cards.
Now, each Hero has 35 common cards and 15 unique cards that are only present in that hero's deck.
An increase from 30 to 95 unique opportunity cards.
Heroes now have colored icons, and their unique Opportunities display that icon in the top-right corner.

[h3]Spite[/h3]
Spite 2: Changed from 3 useless Opportunities to "Gain 1 Stress when losing an Orientation you did not have"
Spite 3: The Restless Rests Disaster changed to no longer give +1 Despair

[h3]Disasters[/h3]
Sudden Sandstorm: Changed from 7 Stress to 6 Stress, -3 Orientation stays the same
Flash Flood: changed from 2 Opportunities to 3

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

[h3]Disasters[/h3]
There are 10 new disasters that are coming in the next few months to torment you on your desert journey.

[h3]Lore[/h3]
Heroes' feelings matter. In the next update, they will express their feelings and let you know a bit more about themselves

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
Your feedback is heard - an updated tutorial is also on its way.

[h2]Board game[/h2]
Lastly, Azoove, the board game, is now under development! Stay tuned.


[h3]As always, your [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]feedback[/url] is greatly appreciated. Thank you for playing! You are why we make games.[/h3]

notes.title: Minor patch 0.7.5 - Quality of life
notes.content:
[h3]This patch has a few minor changes to improve some quality of life:[/h3]

- When Opportunities resolve, both opportunities are shown in parallel and linger longer for better clarity
- AI will no longer use ration decreasing Opportunities when at 0 rations, potentially ending a run
- Fixed raycast issue making some areas of cards not clickable

- Spite 4: Fear of Starvation no longer adds a despair on the last day, preventing a feel-bad moment of getting a rest day from having low rations despite having enough to reach Miz'rak

- Hearts pulse when low health heartbeat sound is played
- Tendrils indicating rest days pulse when about to rest
- Sorting order of one of the food crates fixed to be inside the cart


The next patch should include some balance tweaks, if you have any balance input let us know on the [url=https://discord.gg/ja6SYRydjX]Discord[/url]

[h2]Thank you all for playing![/h2]
